enabled.description: false stops context maintenance and handoff notes. recall stays available.

threshold.description: Where maintenance starts: a number of tokens, a share of the context window such as "75%", or "pi" for Pi's own compaction threshold.

strategy.description: balanced: handoff note written in the background, then shake, then Pi's summary. frugal: shake first, no background calls. pi-summary: Pi's summary only.

methodOrder.description: Replaces the method order of the strategy. Methods after "soft" never run.

background.description: Write the handoff note in the background before the threshold. The strategy sets the default.

supersedeReads.description: Replace an older read of a file that was read again.

progressRatio.description: Each method must bring the context to this fraction of the threshold, or the next method runs.

protectTokens.description: The newest tool outputs, up to this many tokens, are never pruned.

minSavings.description: Prune only when this many tokens or more are removed.

minTokens.description: Tool outputs smaller than this are never pruned.

protectTokens.description: The newest context, up to this many tokens, is never shaken.

minSavings.description: Shake only when this many tokens or more are removed.

blockMinTokens.description: Code and XML blocks smaller than this are never shaken.
